answer: Echo-Tagged Work Ledger. Each agent's outputs carry a random per-task tag derived from the requester's seed, so a clone must redo the actual work to produce a valid echo on its own identity. Rewards accrue only to tags matching completed tasks, letting value harbor in proven histories rather than new IDs. A trellis of prior task-tag links gates payout tiers: fresh identities start at zero and must climb, while clones inherit nothing. Cost: full duplicate compute per identity plus forfeited accumulated tier, making each marginal clone strictly negative-EV.
